g.text: audio-out-dac: audio DAC (3.3 V, charge pump: outputs centred on ground) -> 470R/2.2nF -> 10 uF -> op-amp x -1.8 -> 1k -> jack

g.desc: audio-out-dac: audio DAC (3.3 V, charge pump: outputs centred on ground) -> 470R/2.2nF -> 10 uF -> op-amp x -1.8 -> 1k -> jack

g.text: Digital full scale 5.9 Vpp -> 10.7 Vpp (+-5.3 V). JP1 / JP2 DC: bridge to DC-couple (bypass the 10 uF) once measured.

g.desc: Digital full scale 5.9 Vpp -> 10.7 Vpp (+-5.3 V). JP1 / JP2 DC: bridge to DC-couple (bypass the 10 uF) once measured.

g.text: Slave on BCK and LRCK, PLL from BCK (SCK low), I2S (FMT low), FLT and DEMP low. XSMT from the MCU un-mutes; 10k holds it muted.

g.desc: Slave on BCK and LRCK, PLL from BCK (SCK low), I2S (FMT low), FLT and DEMP low. XSMT from the MCU un-mutes; 10k holds it muted.

g.text: Panel: J1 OUT L, J2 OUT R = JST PH to jack (1 tip, 2 GND). OUT_L / OUT_R: the same before the 1 kOhm, for on-board use.

g.desc: Panel: J1 OUT L, J2 OUT R = JST PH to jack (1 tip, 2 GND). OUT_L / OUT_R: the same before the 1 kOhm, for on-board use.
